what: 00957 split (docs/v2/plan/lanes/codegen/names.md, The split): binding names leave the code key. Today hir_ty_share::code::with_spans hashes the bindings names (NAMES_DOMAIN) into every body code key because the template side record holds them (v2/side.rs Variable::name: Symbol, filled by v2/backend.rs named), so renaming a local reruns MIR codegen. Change: side::Variable holds the binding by its index in its owner store (u32), never the name; whatever writes a variable debug record reads the name from the current database by (owner, binding), as v2/linked.rs reads positions at the link; then with_spans drops NAMES_DOMAIN in the same change. Bump side::VERSION and SIDE_DOMAIN. Test: renaming a local keeps Hashes::code and the template, and the debug record names the new name, equal to a fresh build. Paths not codegen-names: v2/side.rs, v2/backend.rs (lane speed), crates/hir-ty-share/src/code.rs, and the debug record writer (01004).

history.note: hir-ty-codegen v2/side.rs (Variable and Told by binding index, VERSION 4, SIDE_DOMAIN side 4), v2/backend.rs named; test v2/tests.rs renaming_a_local_keeps_what_its_function_tells_a_debugger. The key half (hir-ty-share code.rs drops NAMES_DOMAIN, identity test) is queue 01386 for the coordinator; the name reader is 01354.
